citation: Hayes et al. (2017), Tectonic Summaries of Magnitude 7 and Greater Earthquakes from 2000 to 2015, USGS Open-File Report 2016-1192
evidence_used: Event-specific tectonic summaries for M7+ Banda Sea, Timor, Molucca Sea, North Sulawesi, Buru (2001 M7.5 usp000ar78), and Moro Gulf deep-slab events from 2000 through 2015.
limitations_and_caveats: Scope limited to M7+ through 2015; excludes M6.5-6.9 and post-2015 M7+ events (such as 2018 M7.5 Palu and 2021 M7.3 Flores Sea).

citation: Hasterok et al. (2022), New Maps of Global Geological Provinces and Tectonic Plates, Earth-Science Reviews 231, 104069
evidence_used: Subplate overlays across Banda Sea (20), Molucca Sea (19), Timor (16), Halmahera (5), North Sulawesi (5), Buru (2), plus 13 Moro Gulf events in Sunda polygon.
limitations_and_caveats: Surface subplates do not separate shallow crustal/collision events from intermediate/deep slab events (to >600 km depth).

citation: Bird (2003), An updated digital model of plate boundaries, Geochemistry, Geophysics, Geosystems 4(3), 1027
evidence_used: Plate boundary discretization across Banda Sea, Timor, Molucca Sea, Birds Head, and Sunda plates.
limitations_and_caveats: Surface plate boundaries only; does not represent doubly-vergent Molucca Sea slab geometry or curved Banda slab.

citation: Hayes et al. (2018), Slab2, a comprehensive subduction zone geometry model, Science 362(6410), 58-61
evidence_used: 3D slab geometry reference for Banda spoon-shaped slab, Molucca inverted-U double slab, North Sulawesi trench, and Celebes/Sangihe deep slabs.
limitations_and_caveats: Regional 3D slab context; individual event mechanisms require ComCat detail product verification.
